detail.zh: 新增300107的8条原生记录：6月25日因子仍从9.864变为9.865。短查询能返回，不能把问题仅归因于断连；G2利润仍未确认。
detail.en: Eight native records obtained for 300107: the June 25 factor still changes from 9.864 to 9.865. Short queries work; connectivity alone does not explain the blocker. G2 profit remains unavailable.

evidence.zh: 已核对当地日线前收与股本记录，尚不能解释该变化。保留原始数据，不放宽检查、不将未知分红当零；未重跑账本或启动G3，没有实盘信号。
evidence.en: Local previous-close and share-capital records were checked; the change remains unexplained. Raw data and strict checks are preserved; unknown dividends are not zero. No ledger rerun, G3 start or live signal.

detail.zh: 9月8日日线与官方科创50已补齐；全A股月度Top20评分完成。资金账本暂停于300107的2024年6月25日复权变动，尚无可确认利润。
detail.en: Daily data and official STAR50 reach September 8; all-A monthly Top20 scores are computed. The ledger stopped at the June 25, 2024 factor change in 300107. Profit remains unavailable.

evidence.zh: 428/428份分红历史、50项针对性测试完成，仍有16项分红条款未知。300641的3条来源差异只修正研究副本；后续原生查询连接失败。不是盈利策略，未生成实盘指令，当前没有后台计算在运行。
evidence.en: 428/428 dividend histories and 50 targeted tests completed; 16 event terms remain unknown. Three source differences for 300641 were corrected only in the research copy. Follow-up native queries failed to connect. No profit qualification or live orders; no calculation is currently running.

detail.zh: 全A股月度动量候选：最多20只，保留仍入选的持仓。选股模块已生成，资金账本正在实现。
detail.en: All-A monthly momentum candidate: up to20 names, retaining selected incumbents. Ranking module exists; the capital ledger is being implemented.

evidence.zh: 规则先于结果冻结，这是本批第2个候选。尚无收益结果；开盘成交容量未验证，不可实盘。
evidence.en: Rules frozen before results; candidate2 of this batch. No profit result yet. Opening execution capacity remains unverified; no live trading.

detail.zh: 日线、复权、每日指标、涨跌停均补齐12/12；官方科创50更新到9月8日。只增量入库，旧历史未覆盖。
detail.en: Daily bars, adjustments, daily metrics and limits each12/12 complete. Official STAR50 reaches September8. Additive publication; old history unchanged.

evidence.zh: 新增66,565条日线、66,761条复权、66,565条每日指标、67,583条涨跌停；三组日线关联缺失均为0。4项针对性测试通过。
evidence.en: Added66,565 daily bars,66,761 adjustments,66,565 daily metrics and67,583 limits. All three daily-key joins have zero missing rows. Four targeted tests passed.

detail.zh: 后续从全A股选股，目标为扣费后跑赢科创50。现有日线到8月21日，执行用分钟数据到8月7日，不覆盖全A股。
detail.en: Future selection covers all A-shares, aiming to beat STAR50 net of costs. Existing daily data ends August 21; execution-minute data ends August 7 and does not cover all A-shares.

evidence.zh: 只读检查与3项针对性测试已完成。G1未跑赢基准、实盘可行性未通过；2026年9月9日信号暂不可用。
evidence.en: Read-only checks and three targeted tests completed. G1 underperformed and execution feasibility has not passed; the September 9, 2026 signal is unavailable.

detail.zh: 书本图标可查看G1的趋势过滤、持仓保留、费用与成交限制；保留其科创板历史范围。
detail.en: The book icon explains G1 trend filters, retention, costs and execution limits; its historical STAR-only universe is preserved.

evidence.zh: 依据冻结策略说明，不把借鉴GitHub等同于复现收益；用户已授权后续验证完成后自动同步官网。
evidence.en: Based on the frozen strategy specification. GitHub inspiration is not a return reproduction; the user authorized automatic publication after validation.

detail.zh: 本地玻璃界面已接入四组真实研究曲线、工作记录及原功能入口；首页仅保留图标、数值与日期。
detail.en: Local glass UI includes four actual research curves, recorded work and original workspace entry points; the default surface keeps only icons, numbers and dates.

evidence.zh: 14项前端数据测试通过；电脑、手机、双语、曲线切换与本地旧功能已检查。新研究曲线尚未公开发布；私人账户仅限本机。
evidence.en: Fourteen frontend data tests passed; desktop, mobile, bilingual controls, curve selection and a local legacy module checked. New curves are not publicly released; private accounts remain local.

detail.zh: 模拟千万元终值为10,035,343.31元，扣费后+0.35%；仅8笔平仓交易，未跑赢基准。
detail.en: Simulated CNY10M ended at CNY10,035,343.31, +0.35% net. Only eight closed trades; benchmark underperformance.

evidence.zh: 2025-01-02至2026-08-07的顺序资金账本；总费用24,743.78元，平均仓位4.00%。不是盲测或实盘盈利证明。
evidence.en: Sequential capital ledger, 2025-01-02 to 2026-08-07. Costs CNY24,743.78; mean exposure 4.00%. Not a blind test or proof of live profitability.

detail.zh: 复用136份已下载历史，只补齐5份本候选需要的分红历史；未知分红没有改写为零。
detail.en: Reused 136 existing histories and fetched only five additional histories required by this candidate; unknown dividends were not replaced with zero.

evidence.zh: Claude编写接续模块，Codex完成6项针对性测试；原G1的5项测试通过。属于同上下文测试，不是独立审计。
evidence.en: Claude implemented the resume module; Codex completed six targeted tests. Five original G1 tests passed. Same-context testing, not independent audit.

detail.zh: 依据真实桌面与手机截图，增强玻璃层次，收起重复卡片。
detail.en: Based on actual desktop and phone screenshots: stronger glass separation and quieter history layers.

evidence.zh: Claude Opus 5 提出建议，Codex 已实现；静态截图不能证明动效质量。
evidence.en: Advice from Claude Opus 5, implemented by Codex. Still screenshots alone cannot establish motion quality.

detail.zh: 玻璃界面、双语、历史抽屉与日夜模式已可操作。
detail.en: Glass interface, bilingual controls, history drawers and day/night modes are working.

evidence.zh: 8 项记录测试通过；桌面与手机交互已检查。记录不代表后台仍在持续运行。
evidence.en: Eight feed tests passed; desktop and phone interactions checked. A record is not a continuous process heartbeat.

detail.zh: Claude Opus 建议以磨砂玻璃层表达现在与历史，减少文字，移除侧栏。
detail.en: Claude Opus proposed frosted strata for now and history, minimal copy and no sidebar.

evidence.zh: 已收到设计建议；这不是用户验收或独立审计。
evidence.en: Design advice received. This is neither user acceptance nor an independent audit.

detail.zh: 代码与针对性测试草稿已生成。按照新的优先级，先完成 HHH。
detail.en: Implementation and targeted test drafts exist. HHH takes priority before research resumes.

evidence.zh: 尚未运行测试或回测；不能据此判断策略有效。
evidence.en: Tests and backtest have not run. Strategy validity is not established.

detail.zh: 已完成已有账本的同口径复现；历史结果与新增策略研究分开保留。
detail.en: Same-spec replay of the existing ledger completed. Historical results remain separate from new strategy research.

evidence.zh: 复现曲线与已保存曲线数值一致；不等于成交容量或可部署性验证。
evidence.en: Replayed NAV matches the saved curve numerically; this does not validate capacity or deployability.
